desc:
Pick a bike, choose your track, and ride. Experience motocross like never before with realistic physics, detailed bikes, and an immersive riding experience.

Whether you're hitting massive jumps, throwing whips, mastering corners, or pushing your limits on the track, every ride is yours to make.

- Fully Realistic Motocross Physics
- Variety of dirt bikes to choose from
- Multiple tracks and riding environments
- Freestyle riding and massive jumps
- Detailed bikes and rider gear
- Immersive motocross experience

Please Note: This game is in early development, there may be bugs. Chambers Creek MX and Trials More Pits are currently facing collision / geometry issues.
